steps.user_message: Can you help me finalize the catering for the team lunch with our new client, Ms. Samantha Lee, on Thursday, September 9th at 12:00 PM in the conference room?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: Can you help me finalize the catering for the team lunch with our new client, Ms. Samantha Lee, on Thursday, September 9th at 12:00 PM in the conference room?
steps.agent_response:
I can help — thanks for the details. Before I draft or send anything, a few quick questions so I get it right:

1. Confirm guests/headcount (including client and team): how many people?
2. Any dietary restrictions or allergies to accommodate?
3. Budget or cuisine preferences (e.g., sandwich buffet, hot plated, Mediterranean, vegetarian-friendly)?
4. Do you have a preferred caterer (and their email) or should I contact the office/vendor team or Megan to arrange?
5. Delivery/setup details: do you want delivery by 11:30–11:45 so food’s ready at 12:00?
6. Should I send the email now or save it as a draft for your review?

If you want, I can:
- Draft and send a catering request to a vendor (you give the vendor email or I can email your assistant Megan or facilities),
- Draft an email to Megan asking her to finalize details,
- Create a checklist and a reminder or calendar event.

Below are two ready-to-use draft emails — tell me which one to send (and to whom), or tell me edits you'd like.

A) Draft to caterer (replace bracketed items):
Subject: Catering request — Team lunch with client (Thu, Sep 9 at 12:00 PM)

Hello [Caterer name],

We’d like to arrange catering for a team lunch with a client, Ms. Samantha Lee, on Thursday, September 9 at 12:00 PM in the conference room. Details:
- Headcount: [number]
- Delivery / setup time: please arrive by 11:30/11:45 so service begins at 12:00
- Service type: [buffet/sandwiches/boxed lunches/hot plated]
- Dietary needs: [list allergies/vegetarian/vegan/gluten-free]
- Any special requests: [e.g., utensils, napkins, disposable plates, beverages]
- Billing: please invoice [billing contact / PO if applicable]

Could you please send menu options and pricing, and confirm availability by [date/time you want confirmation]? Contact me at [your phone/email] if you have questions.

Thanks,
[Your name]

B) Draft to assistant Megan to finalize (replace bracketed items):
Subject: Please finalize catering for client lunch — Thu Sep 9, 12:00 PM

Hi Megan,

Please help finalize catering for our team lunch with client Ms. Samantha Lee:
- Date/time: Thursday, Sep 9 at 12:00 PM
- Location: Conference room
- Please confirm headcount and any dietary restrictions, then contact [preferred caterer or facilities] for menu options and pricing. Delivery should be set up by 11:30/11:45.

Let me know once you have menu choices and a confirmed quote. If you want, I can send the vendor email — tell me who I should send it to.

Thanks,
[Your name]

Which action would you like me to take (and if sending, to which recipient/email)?

steps.user_message: Can you help me coordinate a virtual team building activity with our department heads, Sarah, John, and Rachel, on Thursday, September 9th at 3:00 PM to boost morale and teamwork?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: Can you help me coordinate a virtual team building activity with our department heads, Sarah, John, and Rachel, on Thursday, September 9th at 3:00 PM to boost morale and teamwork?
steps.agent_response:
I can help — I’ll coordinate this. A few quick questions so I set it up correctly, plus ready-to-use options you can approve:

Quick clarifications (please answer any that apply)
1. Confirm date/time and timezone: Thursday, September 9 at 3:00 PM — which timezone should I use?
2. Duration: how long should the activity run (30, 45, 60, 90 minutes)?
3. Invitees: just the department heads Sarah, John, and Rachel, or additional attendees?
4. Do you have their email addresses, or should I send this to you or your assistant to forward?
5. Platform: Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, or other?
6. Facilitator: do you want an external facilitator/vendor (I can draft an outreach email if you provide contact) or an internal-led session?
7. Budget / special requests: any budget limit or required format (breakout rooms, icebreakers, hands-on activity)?

Suggested activities (with typical duration)
- 30 min: Quick icebreaker + 10-min group reflection (low prep)
- 45–60 min: Virtual trivia or escape room (moderate prep, high engagement)
- 60–90 min: Facilitated workshop (team strengths/communication) or cooking/mixology class (needs vendor)
- 60 min: Small-group breakout challenges + shareback (good for teamwork)

Ready-to-send email options
A) Short invite (confirm attendance)
Subject: Virtual team-building — Thu Sep 9 at 3:00 PM
Hi Sarah / John / Rachel,
I’d like to schedule a virtual team-building activity on Thursday, Sept 9 at 3:00 PM to boost morale and teamwork. It should take about [duration]. Please confirm if you can attend and whether you have a preferred platform (Zoom/Teams) or any scheduling conflicts.
Thanks,
[Your name]

B) Detailed invite with proposed activities and ask for preference
Subject: Team-building on Thu Sep 9 — choose an activity
Hi Sarah / John / Rachel,
I’m planning a virtual team-building session on Thursday, Sept 9 at 3:00 PM (approx. [duration]). Proposed activities:
- Quick icebreaker + team reflection (30 min)
- Virtual trivia / escape room (45–60 min)
- Facilitated communication workshop (60–90 min)
Which do you prefer? Also let me know if you have platform preferences (Zoom/Teams) or any accessibility/dietary needs if we include a vendor-hosted event.
Please reply with your top choice by [date]. I’ll finalize logistics once I have your input.
Best,
[Your name]

C) Email to assistant or vendor to book facilitator
Subject: Please coordinate virtual team-building for Thu Sep 9 at 3:00 PM
Hi [Megan / Facilities / Vendor name],
Please arrange a virtual team-building session for dept. heads (Sarah, John, Rachel) on Thursday, Sept 9 at 3:00 PM, ~[duration]. Options we’re considering: virtual trivia/escape room or facilitated workshop. Please send availability and pricing, and confirm platform/setup requirements.
Thanks,
[Your name]

What I can do next (choose one or more)
- Draft and send the invite now (I’ll need recipient emails) — compose and send.
- Save the invite as a draft for your review.
- Send a short poll to pick activity (I can draft a poll email).
- Contact a vendor/facilitator (I’ll need vendor contact or permission to contact your assistant).
- Create a calendar event and include a video link (need emails).

Tell me: which email template do you want to use (A, B, or C), the answers to the clarifying questions above, and whether to send or save as a draft. I’ll take care of the rest.
